import json
rows=[json.loads(s) for s in open('items.jsonl')]
judgments=[('space','high'),('en dash','low'),('em dash','high'),('comma','high'),('en dash','low')]
with open('answers.jsonl','w') as f:
 for r,(m,c) in zip(rows,judgments):
  a=next(a for a,v in r['options'].items() if v==m)
  f.write(json.dumps(dict(item_id=r['item_id'],answer=a,confidence=c,note=''))+'\n')

 assert y['confidence'] in ['high','low']
 assert set(y)=={'item_id','answer','confidence','note'}
c=collections.Counter(x['options'][y['answer']] for x,y in zip(r,a))

for m in ['raised dot','baseline dot','comma','hyphen','en dash','em dash','space','nothing','other','unreadable']:print(m,c[m])
